fieldValues.title: The bug fixer's seat was ratified but no routine runs it, so the bug queue has no consumer
fieldValues.summary: Decision 4a44396a (ratified) gives agent:bug-fixer the builder seat in every group and says its trigger runs routines/bug-fixer.md (clerk#151). No enabled trigger runs that brief: the only bug-fixer trigger is the older 'SRS Bug Fixer' (trig_01HjsX1ohcEytbrLpWtbsENg), disabled and running its own prompt, not the brief. On 2026-11-02 clerk queue --bugs listed 15 queued bugs (1 P0, 13 P1, 1 P2) and 2 held. Bugs never enter the Ready feed by design, so nothing else takes them.
fieldValues.body: A ratified decision whose switch-on step names a trigger is not done until the trigger runs; nothing checks that. clerk routines --check would flag a standing-job record without a trigger, but the bug fixer has no standing-job record (handbook: 'bug-fixer (no standing job yet)'), so the drift is invisible.
